coach: written by hand - the routine hit a stale Garmin token
headline: Tuesday landed exactly as written, and your resting heart rate is the lowest it has been all block.
body:
**2,020 m at 2:04/100 m on 131 bpm**, then 35 minutes of Legs at 96. That is the swim and the gym, both done, and the first session of the peak week banked. The swim only reached Garmin late, which is why it looked missing this morning.

The better number is underneath it: **resting HR 45, down three mornings running** from 48, and the lowest since 24 August. Deep sleep jumped to 89 minutes. HRV sits at 60 against a 14-day mean of 63, so Garmin still says Unbalanced, but everything else is moving the right way — that matches what you said about feeling recovered.

Today is the bike: 20 min warm-up, then **2 x 18 min at 140-150 bpm** with 8 min easy between. On the Wattbike make that **135-145 bpm at cadence 85-95** — five beats lower, because indoors runs hot with no airflow. Push tonight.

This is the session that earns Saturday's 85 km. Ride it controlled.
